name: D.P.S. SG
source:
D.P.S. SG is the second entry in the D.P.S./Dream Program System series. Like the other D.P.S. games, it is a collection of three short scenarios, which are unrelated to each other story-wise and can be played separately. Those scenarios are presented as cartridges played on a fictional console named Dream Program System. Each scenario allows the player to choose between two different protagonists, or two different personalities for the protagonist. All of the scenarios feature nudity and/or sexual situations.

The scenarios in this game include:
1. A traditional account of a private lesson given by an experienced male tutor to a cute teenage girl. It can be player as either the teacher or the student, the latter involving deliberately giving wrong answers to English questions in order to gain time to seduce the teacher.

2. An episode entitled Fahnen Fliegen (German for "flags flying"), depicting capture and torture of a female war prisoner by an SS officer. The player can choose to control the officer, effectively torturing the victim himself, or take the role of a soldier who tries to ease her pain, hoping to gain her sexual favors.

3. A scenario set in the Sengoku period of the Japanese history, in the house of the famous warlord Oda Nobunaga. It is possible to play this scenario as Nobunaga himself, or as his daughter, the spoiled princess. In either case, the goal is to seduce the cute maid who works in the house.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/dps-sg]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《D.P.S. SG》是《D.P.S.／梦幻程序系统》系列第二作。与其他《D.P.S.》作品一样，本作由三段彼此毫无关联、可以单独游玩的短篇剧情组成，并将它们包装成虚构主机“梦幻程序系统”上的游戏卡带。每段剧情都允许玩家在两名不同主角之间作出选择，或为同一主角选择两种不同性格。所有剧情均含有裸体和／或性情境。

本作收录以下剧情：
1.一段传统的私人授课故事，由经验丰富的男家教辅导可爱的少女。玩家可以扮演教师或学生；选择后者时，少女会故意答错英语题，以便争取时间诱惑老师。

2.《旗帜飞扬》（Fahnen Fliegen）讲述一名女战俘遭党卫军军官俘虏并拷打的故事。玩家可以扮演军官，亲手折磨受害者；也可以扮演一名试图减轻她痛苦、期望换取性回报的士兵。

3.故事发生在日本战国时代著名大名织田信长的宅邸。玩家可以扮演信长本人，也可以扮演他娇生惯养的女儿；无论选择哪一方，目标都是诱惑宅中的可爱女仆。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/dps-sg]Moby Games[/url]]
